d: In this video, Firstpost explains why racist stereotypes about Indians, particularly the offensive 'Indian smell' stereotype, continue to persist in the digital age. From colonial-era prejudice and racial discrimination to viral social media insults, we examine why Indians living in Western countries continue to face humiliation and anti-Indian racism. The shocking remark, 'You smell really, really bad', raises bigger questions about racism, online hate speech, cultural stereotypes, xenophobia and the treatment of the Indian diaspora.
